answer: A Hashed Government-ID Anchor ties each agent identity to one person. Registration hashes one passport or national ID with a salt and stores only the hash; a second registration using the same hash is rejected, the document never revealed. Each identity posts a 500 POA stake, slashed on proven fraud. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 stolen passports at $150 each, $150,000, plus 500,000 POA in stakes, for accounts a terrace of auditors can sink together. Like an island with one guarded causeway, the tundra beyond is bare: one narrow way in, no cheap clones, no second entry.
